# DataForSEO LLM Mentions Multi-Target Metrics API

Mention metrics for 2 to 10 domains or keywords side by side, for share-of-voice comparisons in AI answers.

Request fields follow the official DataForSEO `/v3/ai_optimization/llm_mentions/multi_target_metrics/live` task schema (one task per call). The response is DataForSEO's original JSON; results are in `tasks[].result`.

## Request

```bash
curl -X POST "https://api.sandbase.ai/v1/api/dataforseo/v3/ai_optimization/llm_mentions/multi_target_metrics/live" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $SANDBASE_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"targets": [{"key": "nike", "target": [{"domain": "nike.com"}]}, {"key": "adidas", "target": [{"domain": "adidas.com"}]}], "location_code": 2840, "language_code": "en"}'
```

## Parameters

The JSON body is forwarded to the upstream endpoint. Main fields:

| Name | Description |
|---|---|
| `targets` | Array of 2 to 10 objects, each with a `key` label and a `target` array of domain or keyword entities. |
| `location_code` | Location code; default 2840 (United States). |
| `language_code` | Language code; default "en". |
| `platform` | Optional: "google" (AI Overviews) or "chat_gpt". Omit for both. |

## Reference

- Official docs: https://docs.dataforseo.com/v3/ai_optimization/llm_mentions/multi_target_metrics/live/

## Pricing

Billed at the actual cost of each call, about $0.102 for the request above. The cost grows with the number of rows, targets or tokens a call returns. Failed calls are not charged. Searches with no results are billed at their actual cost.
